name: Fraternal Order of Eagles #34
description: Eagles #34 is a welcoming and eclectic venue known for its lively karaoke scene. It offers a variety of rooms and multiple stages, hosting karaoke nights several times a week, including themed nights and competitions. The venue features a decent sound system, a broad song library, and friendly staff. Guests can enjoy affordable drinks, food, and a diverse crowd that appreciates good music and community spirit. Its inclusive atmosphere makes it a favorite spot for locals and visitors alike seeking fun, entertainment, and social connection.
